description: PAID ($0.009 USDC via x402). Should your agent touch this token? One call returns a 0-100 safety score, a grade (A-F), a verdict (low_risk, medium_risk, high_risk, critical_risk), the reasons that took points off and what speaks for it, the scanner's own flags (identical to token_safety), and the deepest DEX pair's price, liquidity, volume and age. Works for an ERC-20 on base, ethereum, polygon, arbitrum, optimism, bsc or avalanche, and for a Solana mint (send the base58 address; chain is inferred). The scoring rules are published in every answer (method). Send no body to get USDC on Base. Rule-based risk signals, not investment advice. Without payment this returns the 402 challenge; the fiatdock-mcp npm package pays automatically. Any answer the tool cannot produce is >= 400 and is NOT charged.

chain.description: Chain. Default: solana for a base58 mint, base for a 0x address

payment.description: Base64 of a single x402 v2 PaymentPayload (EIP-3009 transferWithAuthorization on Base USDC). OMIT it on the first call: the 402 you get back carries `howToPay.payloadTemplate` — the exact envelope to fill in — plus the price and the EIP-712 domain. Send it on the second call to complete the purchase; it is forwarded as the PAYMENT-SIGNATURE header, never as body data. Nothing is charged for the 402 itself, and a call that fails after payment settles nothing.

token.description: Token address: an ERC-20 contract (0x…) or a Solana mint (base58). Omit the whole body to get USDC on Base

name: token_verdict

asOf.description: ISO time of the oldest upstream read this answer used

defaulted.description: Present only when the body was empty: which subject the answer is for, and why

holders.description: Holder count and the largest holder's share of supply, when the scanner reports them

issuerControls.description: Issuer control powers reported but not scored, because the token is trusted or an issuer-run token at its canonical address

firstPairAgeHours.description: Age of the oldest pair the token trades in on this chain, as base or quote — the age the score uses

pairListCut.description: True when DexScreener returned its maximum of 30 pairs, so the oldest seen is a lower bound and the age rule is not applied

market.description: The deepest DEX pair where this token is the base token (DexScreener); null when none

name.description: Token name — the deployer's text, clamped

network.description: Chain the token was read on (base, ethereum, …, or solana)

note.description: What the verdict is and is not

pageUrl.description: Public page for this token's last paid verdict on fiatdock.com

positives.description: What speaks for the token (trusted listing, deep liquidity, age, holder count)

reasons.description: Everything that took points off the score, worst first — the score is 100 plus their points, clamped to 0-100

risks.description: The scan's risk flags with no trust applied (on EVM exactly as token_safety reports them; on Solana by this tool's rules)

safetyScore.description: 0-100, higher is safer, by the stated method

summary.description: One sentence: the verdict and its main reason

symbol.description: Token symbol — the deployer's text, clamped
